title: Enforcement Directorate, Tamil-English code-mix, account and UPI
turns: Vanakkam amma, naan Enforcement Directorate officer pesuren. Unga Aadhaar-la oru money laundering case irukku.
Ungala arrest panna warrant ready-a irukku amma. Jail pogaama irukkanum-na naan solradha kelunga.
Yaarukkum sollaadheenga, phone-a cut pannaadheenga. Zoom call-la join pannunga.
Rs 1.2 lakh RBI verification-ku anuppanum. Account number 6677 8899 0011 22, Canara Bank.
Sari amma. Illa-na GPay-la ed.case2026@okicici ku anuppunga.
